Nova (NASDAQ: NVMI) is a globally operating company and a leading provider of innovative metrology and process control solutions for semiconductor manufacturing.

With around 1,600 employees, 4 research and development centers, and 31 locations worldwide, we deliver valuable insights into the world’s most advanced industry. We leverage a variety of technological disciplines – including physics, optics, chemistry, and algorithms – to develop hardware and software solutions that measure virtually every modern computer chip in the world. Nova looks down to the atomic level, gains unique insights through dimensional, material, and chemical metrology, and provides customers with actionable data. This enables us to tackle critical challenges with differentiated solutions. Our exceptional, people-focused, and innovation-driven corporate culture ensures that every individual at Nova has the opportunity to make a real impact and push the boundaries of what is technologically possible.

Sentronics Metrology GmbH was recently acquired by Nova and is a leading company in the field of high-precision measurement solutions for semiconductor manufacturing. Based in Mannheim, Sentronics brings over 25 years of experience in developing state-of-the-art metrology systems. The integration of Sentronics is already well underway. Sentronics is now a permanent part of the Nova family and shares the same values: innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction. The combination of Nova’s global presence and Sentronics’ advanced technology and expertise create a unique platform for growth and innovation. As part of Nova, Sentronics will fully benefit from the exciting opportunities in the rapidly evolving semiconductor industry.

As Head of Product Marketing (m/f/d) at Sentronics Metrology (a Nova Company) in Mannheim, you will take on a key leadership role in driving the divisional product marketing strategy for our high-precision metrology solutions within the semiconductor industry. Your mission is to translate complex technological capabilities into clear market value, expand our footprint with key global customers, and lead the full product lifecycle in close collaboration with R&D, Sales, and Application teams.

We are looking for creative minds with high ambitions who see the seemingly impossible as a challenge and love to achieve innovative breakthroughs in a global, multidisciplinary team.

Please submit your application in English.

For questions, feel free to contact us at talents@novami.com (https://mailto:talents@novami.com) .

Responsibilities

- Leading divisional product management, marketing, and application development activities
- Driving the divisional product development lifecycle in close collaboration with R&D and Sales
- Developing and driving competitive positioning and value propositions to enable regional sales success
- Driving technical review meetings with key customers to expand Sentronics AP market share
- Representing Sentronics at global trade shows, including SEMICON, and delivering speaking engagements at technology conferences
- Aligning with internal and external stakeholders on customer demo development and execution
- ·Aligning cross-divisional segmentation strategies with other Nova divisions
- Acting as the primary representative of Sentronics/Nova across all company-wide marketing initiatives and events

Requirements

- Strong scientific background with at least a Master’s degree, preferably in Physics, Optics, or a related field
- 10+ years of relevant industry experience, including at least 5 years in leading technical marketing/product management activities within the semiconductor WFE environment
- Deep, hands-on expertise in metrology requirements within semiconductor fabs
- Proven experience in working with key customers in the semiconductor industry (10B+ USD CapEx)
- Excellent Business-English communication skills, both verbal and written
- High willingness to travel internationally (up to 50%)

Benefits:

- Financial Wellbeing:  Receive a tax- and duty-free cash bonus of €100 per month to use flexibly through our discounts platform and with premium suppliers. Birthday gifts and other non-cash allowance bonuses are also included.
- Overall Wellbeing: Enjoy a free, generous breakfast with fresh fruit, a subsidized lunch, as well as free coffee, tea, and water. Take part in team events, company events, and volunteering activities.
- Flexibility & Time Off: Benefit from a hybrid work environment with flexible hours, remote work options, and flextime. You can also work up to 20 days per year from any country in Europe.
- Job Security: Work for a globally leading provider in the semiconductor industry that is continuously growing and focused on long-term success.
- Professional Development: Continuously develop your skills with individual training programs and our tailored learning platform.

Who we are

Our Product Competence Center Esslingen is a key part of TK Elevator’s global innovation network. On 33,000 square meters, we bring together development, production, testing facilities, and customer experience under one roof. Around 400 employees develop, manufacture, test, and qualify cutting-edge elevator technologies here – including the smart and eco-efficient EOX platform. 
Our modern training workshop allows us to educate and develop new talent at the highest quality level. In addition, we operate a fully digitalized spare parts warehouse of 5,700 square meters, supporting the maintenance of more than 250,000 elevators and escalators in TK Elevator’s global service network

What we expect

- Act as strategic partner to the Business Line Leadership Team, supporting business strategy and growth initiatives
- Analyze customer requirements, market trends and competitive developments to identify business opportunities and drive decision-making
- Drive the translation of strategic priorities into actionable plans and ensure consistent execution across the organization
- Support the continuous development and optimization of target operating models across different business areas
- Lead cross-functional projects and coordinate key stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, Order Management and Field organizations

Who we are looking for

The ideal candidate brings a strong sense of ownership, drives results with confidence and meets the following key requirements:

The Opportunity

We are looking for an SAP HANA Performance Team Leader to plan, execute, and validate the performance of SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV and AOS. This role is responsible for qualifying our software to meet SAP benchmark targets and certifying third-party OEM servers for inclusion in SAP’s certified hardware directory.

About the Team

Nutanix's Solutions & Performance Engineering team is a globally distributed organization of architects, performance engineers, and industry specialists focused on validating, optimizing, and accelerating customer success across strategic workloads and industry ecosystems.

Your Role

- Manage a team of remote employees and subcontractors to benchmark SAP HANA and other SAP software components on bare-metal servers. Virtualize similar configurations on Nutanix AHV using the same hardware to identify and improve performance differences between virtualization and bare metal.
- Deploy and troubleshoot various SAP HANA configurations, and establish and document the Nutanix best practices for this workload.
- Identify new strategies and configurations to improve SAP HANA performance on new software versions and denser hardware specifications that expose performance issues in the platform software.
- Work with core engineering teams to troubleshoot performance issues impacting SAP HANA and determine root causes that can be corrected through code changes.
- Deploy new hardware infrastructure in the SAP Linux lab in Walldorf, Germany, and manage infrastructure dependencies.
- Build strong relationships at SAP Headquarters in Walldorf, Germany to gain support from key stakeholders.
- Align Nutanix strategic outcomes with SAP strategic outcomes and influence SAP stakeholders to support Nutanix goals.
- Guide teams in using SAP HANA test harness tools, including SAP validation and certification suites. Serve as a subject matter expert to support performance teams in qualifying and certifying our solution.
- Analyze results from SAP validation and certification suites, compare them to SAP's KPI thresholds, diagnose failures, and drive issues to root cause across the full stack.
- Provision, configure, and troubleshoot SAP HANA parameters, SLES/RHEL for SAP tuning, vCPU/NUMA topology, kernel scheduling, general storage topologies, virtual storage controllers, and network fabrics.
- Experience with automating hardware and software deployments, infrastructure as code, and APIs.
- Ability to explore how AI can be used to automate processes further using advanced AI models.
- Understand the impact of new CPU and memory innovations on SAP HANA workloads and how Nutanix AHV and AOS must evolve to achieve performance benchmarks close to bare metal.
- Understand both scale-up and scale-out HANA and other key architectures of the SAP HANA database.
- Assist in producing written artifacts including SAP Notes, best practice guides, test plans, and KPI result packages for SAP submissions.
- Develop sizing guidelines, configuration recommendations, and reference architectures for SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV/AOS.
- Help customers and Nutanix sellers on large deals involving SAP HANA.
- Work with hardware OEMs to enable them to achieve their own hardware validations for SAP HANA with Nutanix.
- Assist with Nutanix support escalations.

What You Will Bring

- 5+ years in SAP HANA infrastructure or general database performance engineering, with at least 2 years focused on virtualized HANA.
- Deep Linux OS experience
- Experience with Nutanix HCI
- Performance monitoring tools
- Hands-on experience running SAP HANA test harness validation and certification suites, interpreting KPI results, especially storage latency and throughput tests, and understanding the reasons for test failures.
- Working knowledge of SAP HANA, the SAP HANA hardware directory, and, ideally, SAP's certification requirements for HCI and virtualized deployments.
- Strong Linux performance skills on SLES for SAP or RHEL for SAP, including hugepages, C-states and power governors, NUMA topology, SNC2, I/O schedulers, and the standard observability toolkit (perf, sar, iostat, blktrace, numastat, ftrace).
- Practical experience with virtualization performance, including CPU pinning and NUMA alignment, vCPU-to-pCPU ratios, memory reservation, and virtual storage and network path behavior.
- Nutanix AHV/AOS experience is strongly preferred. ESXi or KVM experience will be considered if the candidate can demonstrate relevant expertise.
- Comfortable with distributed storage concepts, including replication factor, data locality, write path and oplog behavior, and understanding latency percentiles.
- Scripting for automation and analysis (Python, Bash) and familiarity with Ansible or Terraform for repeatable lab builds.
- Excellent communication skills in both English and German, with the ability to engage meaningfully with customers.

Great to have

- Direct involvement in prior SAP HANA hardware, HCI, or cloud certification submissions.
- Experience with SAP HANA System Replication, scale-out landscapes, and HA/DR validation under fault injection.
- Familiarity with SAP application-layer benchmarking (SD benchmark, BW/4HANA or S/4HANA workload profiles) in addition to infrastructure KPIs.
- Nutanix certification (NCP/NCM) or SAP HANA Technology certification.
